summary.description: Odourless white crystals used as an insecticide and fire retardant.
environmental_impact: Highly bioaccumulative and chemically robust, leading to persistence in the environment
Accumulates to harmful levels in aquatic and terrestrial food chains
Strongly adsorbed on sediments, making it difficult to remove

top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Mirex accumulates in aquatic food chains and sediments, causing harmful effects on aquatic organisms and ecosystem health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG15_Life_on_Land: Mirex bioaccumulates in terrestrial food chains, posing risks to wildlife and disrupting ecosystems.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Due to its persistence and sediment adsorption, mirex contaminates water bodies, threatening water quality and sanitation.
